notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
here is video version
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=36cro9F7-Ro

You can finally play the game with controller! Took lots of work but it should be good, if you modified your input.ini file it might not work well so just delete it and the game will replace it.

There is now support for 5 new languages, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese, Russian. However they may be errors. Non Latin characters tend to go way too fast and might be too hard to read. There will be a redo of the dialogue system later on so it will be fixed. Many non English people try to play so I figured it was better to add it in now than have nothing.

The coinshop has been improved with better ui and pictures for each item. Unfortnelty gun skins have been removed, I dont think anyone will care because they were really boring and the game is just too dark for them to work well. However there is now upgrades, for each item there is now a lvl 2 that will give you permanent upgrades. 

the settings menu has been redone and is much more standard now. Lots of new options like Toggle sprinting, disable head bobbing, disabling leaderboard uploads(please use if you are cheating), Separate sensitivity for aiming down sights, and y-axis, more keybind controls and anti aliasing.

Clothing models have been improved slightly, and better cloth physics for the gown. There is a new outfit "casual" the lvl 2 version will spawn in with the armor. 

There is now a discord server as many requested, the link is in the main menu screen on the game, so only people who have the game should join

Parts of the map have been improved with better models and textures and fixed some clipping. The lighting has been changed, it will look much better especially on best settings. Thanks to Miguel del Rio for helping with the environment. 

Some props can now be shot and will react with physics. 

There is now vending machines on the lower level near the farm and added cows in the farm. 

The crates glowing fx have been removed. 

The suppressors and stock have been removed from the mac10 and will be added back for the lvl 2 version, there is no difference other than visual changes. 

Brighter flashlight has been removed from the crates as batteries have been removed.

Socks now also increase your sliding/ rolling distance. 

The monster wont spawn during the intro until you go into the power room

Pain meds will now heal for 30 points instead of 20

Monster's name font has been changed to work with other languages

When you upgrade the ammo it will now also give you more ammo in game instantly

extended mags will now upgrade all guns not just the mac-10 

You will now be forced to open the xpshop the first time you play and the widget wont go away until you do, I don't know why but some people never open the xpshop and then complain the game is too hard.

health bars will now remain at their first stage range so people realize the second stage is weaker

changed quick start name to second run, hopefully this will make it more clear and encourage people to play the other content. Also removed the wall to the ripper dripper while on second run. I want to change second run to be a linear continuation from the story but I ran out of time for this update. 

fixed perk upgrades displaying 300 but only costing 250
fixed the ripper dripper bug where it stops attacking you if you shoot it during a lunge attack
fixed monsters getting stuck on props in the lab
fixed some spelling and changed some dialogue to be less confusing
fixed Sarah flickering naked on ragdoll death
fixed critical hits on deformed squid and birdman when you have nothing upgraded
fixed the baby not getting picked up if you run past it too fast
fixed birdman causing damage on the chain attacks and not killing you, It will now do 0 damage for chain attacks
fixed the ending saying you completed 2 endings when you only completed 1
fixed keyboard getting stuck when pressing escape on notes
fixed other stuff I cant remember

I wanted to add more actual new content for this update but I was really rushing to get the fixes and controller support out, Sadly the refund rate is really really high for this game so I want to fix things before adding new stuff. I think the game is in a good state now.

If you find any bugs please let me know

fixes-

What is next for the game? 
I plan on adding rewards for the top leaderboard spots and also separating the endings again. 

I am also working on a new game mode, A procedural map with random monster spawns and you will have to survive as long as you can. This might change I'm still working it out, right now the procedural map feels very boring to explore, but I want something that you can keep playing over and over and also get rewards for. I am looking into the steam inventory system. 

I can also add more to the story mode, I think the best thing would be blowing up part of the cave with dynamite and have a whole new map that leads into the expanded sewer. If its big enough it could be a dlc. There could be lots of new monsters that have mutated on their own and lots of crazy people living down there like the sewerman. This way I can kind of add whatever monsters and it wont affect the main story. 
If you guys can share the game with friends or streamers to get it more popular it would be great or just post videos online.

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Hello the new update is finally here, here are all the changes and new stuff
here is a video explaining it 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a3BRFSeGoTU




[h1]Better dodging system[/h1]
If you are in first person you will always slide and stay in first person and in third person it will be the roll, also it now boosts you forward properly. Also changed the animation depending on what direction you are going.

[h1]New gun- ak47 [/h1]
This is in the armory like the mac10 but you can only hold 1 secondary at a time, either mac10 or ak47.

[h1]Better xp system[/h1]
You will now get different amounts of xp depending on what monster you kill or quest. You can also get negative xp by doing evil stuff. Also the perk Investor now multiplies a random number between 1.2-2x instead of always being double. People were able to unlock everything way too fast and it made the birdman too easy.

[h1]New mystery crates[/h1]
There are new crates around the map that you can spend xp to spin and get a random item. Each time you spin the price will go up. New items are Night Vision, Free ticket, Socks, Dragon’s Breath, Mac10 extended mags and Brighter flashlight with no battery. 

[h1]4 new boss fights [/h1]
Deformed Squid, this is after the birdman. Not very complex but there needed to be something else to shoot after you just got your new gun. 

Gas- This has replaced the invisible monster, You must survive in the room for 90 seconds while gas monsters constantly spawn in. 

Scrap Stitch Man- The monster banging in the gas chamber can now be let out. He is very fast and has 2 phases. This is now the only monster that will always insta kill jumpscare you. On his second phase he will hide somewhere across the map and infinitely gain health until you find it. 


The Ripper Dripper - A very strong monster that has 3 phases. He has many different attacks and abilities. It is not meant to be killed on your first run, In the future I will probably lock this area off to anyone who hasnt completed a game yet.

[h1]The monster changes[/h1]
The monster can no longer attack you if you are sliding or dodging. Also it can't jump scare you if your health is above 100. Its second phase has been fixed so it doesn't heal past 70. It can no longer smell you through walls and its sound will get more muffled behind walls or floors so you can sense where it is easier. 

[h1]Gun system[/h1]
Much more optimized, You can now shoot the animals in the cage and shoot lights and shoot doors to open them. Also improved the fx. Blood decals will now spawn on the floor and better muzzle flashes and smoke.

[h1]Healing system[/h1]
Healing past max health is still in the game but it will tick down 1 every second until your back at your max health. Also improved the fx so it is less distracting. Health is much more useful now as everything is based on damage instead of instakill (except scrap stitch man)
 

[h1]Map and model Improvements[/h1]
Certain parts of the map have been redone and with more details to help the player be less confused. The area after birdman has been extended with doors that will randomly break with small monsters inside. Fixed some props and optimized certain things. Redid hair for Dellah and Sarah and fixed some clothing and texture problems. 

[h1]4 new side quests[/h1]
New quest with dellah on quickstart, small quest for the doctor in the power room, Lenna quest has been redone and 1 secret quest. Also the intro part with turning the power on has been redone to make it easier for new players to understand what to do.

[h1]Cinematics[/h1]
Added a few more computer movies and switched to names instead of dates. Also Redid and extended some parts of the intro cinematic and flashback cinematic. There is also a new cinematic when you give Leena the baby. Also a new cinematic after you kill the ripper dripper and a new cinematic for dellahs side quest. 

[h1]Talking system[/h1]
All the dialogue has been changed slightly to be more efficient and now uses text instead of string. The characters now have unique talking sounds. Also changed the skip button to be left click instead of space. Also fixed some character restarting after you already talked to them. And new camera animation and head center fx when you talk.

[h1]Options[/h1]
Added sensitivity slider and brightness slider. Also added option for v sync, fps limit and controls will now save properly so you don't have to redo them every time you launch the game. 
The game is now more playable on controllers but menus and ui stuff wont work. I will still work on this but for now this game is still only keyboard and mouse supported. 

[h1]New xp and coin shop[/h1]
The cosmetics page has been separated from xp shop and is only on the Main Menu. There are new gun skins and clothes. You can now change the lab light color from green to red and white. Also added a freecam so you can fly around in slow motion. 

The xp shop is only in the pause menu now. Also the price for extra perks has been raised by 50xp. Also better ui and animations. New perk- resupply. A 20% chance to fire without using a bullet. Removed stamina upgrades. Double tap chance has been lowered.


[h1]Other changes [/h1]

Shotgun suppressor has been removed

The beast fight is now way more optimized and will get double the fps

Added a new smaller monster - crawler, they spawn randomly after Selim is dead 

You can close menus with esc key now

Difficulty has been removed and replaced with optional game mods

Rats don't spawn randomly anymore, they are hand placed so they won't get stuck and they won't move now unless you are in range to save performance.

Redid leaderboard system and ui. 

If you are playing with best settings the lights will be visible from farther away and also emit light farther radius so everything is overall brighter and more visible. Although none of the lights are baked so this will lower fps more. 

Birdman is now slightly faster and has slightly more ranged but reduced damage from sword attacks to 25 from 50 and removed damage from chain pulls

sewer man now only blocks at max 5 times, some people were getting extremely unlucky with him blocking almost every rock at random

Changed the lighting of some things, the flashlight will now be half the color of the lab lights and white. 

Ammo will now spawn separately between shotgun and you secondary weapon

you can no longer jump and slide at the same time

Separated monsters between black blood and red blood

Added more animations to doctors

Redid the map collision so it should be impossible to fall out randomly

Fixed bug where monster would turn on every light in the game making fps low

Added more tips and option to disable them for faster loading

Game will automatically restart instead of going to main menu
Added lab notes and more posters 

Paint drinker will now spawn disk if you shoot him, Too many people didn't get to see the computer movies 

Trip mines are now off after the intro and you must manually activate them

Lights now hum at different frequencies when you pass by them

Flashlight is now more wide and has consistent falloff so people will no longer be overly bright bright or overly dim, third person will be way more playable now 

You can change where you respawn using respawn switches around the map. 

Fixed lots of bugs and optimization problems and other changes I can't remember and secret stuff


If you find and bugs or problems or general feedback please put it in the steam discussion page
I will continue to do hotfixes for this update for the next couple weeks

notes.content:

hello here is an update on the update, I know I said it would be late july but the thing is it just dosnt seem worth it to post yet for like only 15 minutes of new content, I want to add more first, most people don't want to replay this type of game or just refund if they play under 2 hours so I want the update to be big and worth your time to replay rather just a spam bunch of small updates. 
  
Progress is going good it is already a lot better. There will be more monsters and bosses, 1 very hard one, the people complaining that the game is too easy will like him, new guns, new characters, new items and stuff to spend xp on, new way to escape and more cosmetics and more cinematics and lore and lots of improvements on the old monsters and changes on almost everything, too much to type here. 
 
  Watching peoples youtube videos and streams help alot, I got a good idea of what you guys want more of and less of. I know alot want voice acting, I actually started off with voices but it was just too cringe for me so I changed to the noise, I actually prefer how it is now, I may try again, im not gonna use ai voices, im not a fan of ai. 
I don't have a estimated time for update, it will come when its done and will be great.
